text:
sara: Quick heads-up  friend dropping by at 4pm with a bonsai and a tote. Need a visitor badge and a small table by the north window (they prefer daylight). Also might be a small parcel for me today, can you hold it? :seedling:
front-desk: All good. Guests get a day badge and must sign in. North window has a side table (no outlet). We can hold parcels in locker C1. What name should we put on the badge?
sara: Put it under 'Kai Morales'. The parcel is probably addressed to Sara Li. If it arrives, please add a 'fragile' note  it's a decorative bowl.
reception-bot: Visitor badge print requested for "Kai Morales" at 15:52. Badge ID: G-2176.
jaime: FYI, if you want an outlet we can swap to the east standing table  but it's a little noisier. I can move the small table if you prefer.
lucy: Heads-up: mailroom spotted a small box labelled "decorative bowl" with faint perfume smell earlier. Mailroom, DM Sara?
mailroom: Confirmed  package for Sara Li arrived at 15:40, labelled "Fragile - ceramic". Placed in locker C1. No spills detected but there was a light scent. We'll ring when guest checks in.
sara: Thanks, glad it's there. @front-desk could you also flag the bundle if it looks damp? I don't want soil stains on the table.
front-desk: Will do. Reminder: Guests should not bring plants into meeting rooms unless pre-approved. North window seating is fine. We'll provide a small mat.
jaime: I'll shift the side table over in 3 mins and put a 'reserved' sticky.
lucy: Also note for anyone: if you're expecting floral/plant shipments, please include 'no soil' in the delivery notes when possible  we've had issues with critters.
reception-bot: Guest checked in at 16:02. Badge handed. Package status: In locker C1, sticky note "Fragile - keep upright" attached. Called x2004.
sara: You're heroes, thanks! Can someone grab the side table back after 5? Need to get a few calls in.
jaime: Got it, I'll return it at 5:05.
mailroom: Closing loop  package picked up by Sara at 16:15. All good.
sara: Perfect, enjoy the bonsai admiring session :relaxed:
